description: This file defines an Android AppWidgetProvider that updates astrology-related widget content periodically, fetching data asynchronously and updating the widget views with date, star sign (raasi), and nakshatra information, along with click handling to open the main activity.

classes.name: AstrologyWidgetProvider
classes.description: An Android AppWidgetProvider that updates astrology info in app widgets asynchronously.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles widget update events; launches coroutine to fetch astrology data and update all widget instances.

methods.name: updateWidget
methods.description: Updates individual widget view with date, raasi, nakshatra, and click intent to open main activity.
